analysis.summary: Robert is a happy horse who celebrates his birthday on the farm. When he sniffs the roses on his cake, a giant sneeze makes everything fly into the air.

chunks.paraphrased_story_facts: A small horse named Robert who lives on a farm with his parents is cheerful. He is hosting a birthday party where several animal companions from the farm have gathered to celebrate him.
chunks.lookout_prompt: Before you read, watch for who comes to Robert's birthday party.
chunks.checkin_question: Who attended the birthday party that Robert held?

canonical_prototypes.text: All his farm friends came to the party.
the animals who live on the farm

target_mastery.hypothesis: The reader identifies the farm friends as the guests.
target_mastery.feedback: Exactly! His friends joined him for the big day.

minimal_core.feedback: Correct! His friends came to celebrate with him.

superficial_attribute.hypothesis: The reader points to the red house or gifts.
superficial_attribute.scaffold: Look at the animals gathering around Robert—who are they?

premise_echo.scaffold: Look at the animals in the illustration—who came to the party?

character_confusion.hypothesis: The reader says 'his mother and father'.
character_confusion.scaffold: Robert's parents are mentioned earlier, but who came to this party?

distractor_misconception.scaffold: The cake is for the party, but who are the living guests?

chunks.hint_level_1: Look at the animals walking toward Robert in the picture.
chunks.hint_level_2: Who are the animals that Robert knows?
chunks.scaffold_hint: Look at the animals near Robert.
story_facts: Robert is a happy little horse.
Robert lives with his mother and father.
Robert had a party for his birthday.
All of Robert's farm friends came to the party.

chunks.paraphrased_story_facts: The animals possess a large, pink birthday cake for Robert. The cake is decorated with roses that have red petals. Robert is very fond of the roses. He leans down and places his snout inside one of the flowers and inhales deeply.
chunks.lookout_prompt: Before you read, watch for what Robert does to the roses.
chunks.checkin_question: What did Robert do after putting his nose into a rose?

canonical_prototypes.text: He took a big sniff of the rose.
he breathed the scent in deep

target_mastery.hypothesis: The reader states he took a big sniff.
target_mastery.feedback: Right! He took a really big sniff.

superficial_attribute.hypothesis: The reader describes the color of the roses.
superficial_attribute.scaffold: The roses are red, but what did Robert do to them?

premise_echo.scaffold: Look at Robert's face near the flower—what is he doing?

character_confusion.hypothesis: The reader says the friends sniffed the rose.
character_confusion.scaffold: Robert is the one standing by the cake; what is he doing?

distractor_misconception.scaffold: Not yet! First he smells the flower—what is that called?

chunks.hint_level_1: Look at Robert's nose when he leans toward the red flower.
chunks.hint_level_2: What action does he do with his nose?
story_facts: The friends had a big cake.
The cake had big red roses around it.
Robert put his nose into one rose.

chunks.paraphrased_story_facts: Robert begins to experience a strange sensation. His eyes and nose develop an itch. Suddenly, he lets out a powerful sneeze sound written as 'KERCHOO!'. This sneeze is so strong that the cake, the roses, and all his farm friends are blown upward into the sky, and Robert ends up lying flat on the ground.
chunks.lookout_prompt: Before you read, watch for what happens when Robert sneezes.
chunks.checkin_question: What happened to the farm friends when Robert sneezed?

canonical_prototypes.text: His farm friends went up into the air.
they were pushed into the sky by the sneeze

target_mastery.hypothesis: The reader says the friends went up.
target_mastery.feedback: Yes! The sneeze was so big they all flew up!

minimal_core.feedback: Correct! They went way up in the air.

superficial_attribute.hypothesis: The reader describes the cake hitting the ground.
superficial_attribute.scaffold: Look at the animals—where are they in the last picture?

premise_echo.scaffold: When the sneeze happened, where did the friends go?

character_confusion.hypothesis: The reader says Robert went up.
character_confusion.scaffold: Robert fell down flat, but where did his friends go?

distractor_misconception.hypothesis: The reader says they stayed there.
distractor_misconception.scaffold: The sneeze was very strong! Take another look—where are they now?

chunks.hint_level_1: Look at the animals in the final illustration.
chunks.hint_level_2: Where are the friends in the air?
